verdict: CHALLENGE PARTLY UPHELD ON PURITY; AND THE CHEMISTRY PASS FOUND THREE SUBSTANTIVE DATASET ERRORS. 34 oligo_ids carry human clinical rows in curation/studies/cluster_*.json. 7 are pooled/class aggregates for which position-specific chemistry is UNDEFINED, not merely unrecovered. Of the 27 real substances, I confirmed or recovered residue-level chemistry for 22. || THREE LOUD DISAGREEMENTS WITH oligos.csv, reported and deliberately NOT overwritten. (1) TOFERSEN (TOLG256): oligos.csv says full_PS, ps_count 19. The QALSODY label section 11 states in words that of the nineteen internucleotide linkages fifteen are phosphorothioate and FOUR ARE PHOSPHATE DIESTERS, and its molecular formula carries S15 not S19 - falsified twice by one primary document. The full IUPAC name localises the phosphodiesters to linkages 2, 4, 17 and 19. (2) EPLONTERSEN (TOLG061): the stored modification_map is all-PS and is BYTE-IDENTICAL to inotersen's. Eplontersen's own INN chemical name marks each linkage individually and gives 13 PS / 6 PO (PO at 2,3,4,5,16,17). The stored map is wrong on 6 of 19 linkages, carries no trace of the GalNAc3 conjugate, and contradicts the SAME ROW's backbone_chemistry column, which already reads PS_PO_mix. This is a parent-to-derivative copy error. (3) PATISIRAN (TOLG247): oligos.csv lists 2'-F among its sugar modifications. Patisiran contains NO FLUORINE - the ONPATTRO label formula C412H480N148Na40O290P40 has no F, and the CAS name annotates only two 2'-O-methyl residues on the guide strand with every other ribose UNMODIFIED. Probable cross-row contamination from the GalNAc-siRNA rows. || PLUS: oblimersen (TOLG241) and ISIS 3521 (TOLG085) are both typed oligo_class=ASO_gapmer but are first-generation UNIFORM PS oligodeoxynucleotides with no 2'-modified wings - verified by atom arithmetic on their molecular formulas; imetelstat (TOLG070) carries ps_count=0 while actually containing 13 thio-phosphorus centres (12 N3'->P5' thiophosphoramidate plus one real 5'-phosphorothioate); and TOLG073 (IONIS-TTRRx) is THE SAME SUBSTANCE as TOLG072 (inotersen) under a development code, a duplicate identity that defeats the exact_sequence_group leakage control because TOLG073 has no sequence to group on. || CLEAN CONFIRMATIONS, residue for residue and linkage for linkage: inotersen, mipomersen, volanesorsen, olezarsen, ISIS 104838. Volanesorsen and inotersen are also the only two compounds qualifying as DEMONSTRATED_IDENTITY rather than REFERENCE_SEQUENCE - their EPARs show identity established analytically on manufactured active substance. || RECOVERIES from TBD: sequences for imetelstat (TAGGGTTAGACAA), danvatirsen and ISIS 3521; full residue maps for nusinersen, drisapersen, bepirovirsen, custirsen, danvatirsen, fesomersen, oblimersen, alicaforsen, ISIS 3521 and patisiran; ps_counts for eplontersen (13), custirsen (20), danvatirsen (15), oblimersen (17), ISIS 3521 (19) and vutrisiran (6); salt forms for ten compounds. A chemistry fact worth keeping: custirsen's DNA-gap cytosines are NOT 5-methylated and its geometry is 4-13-4, breaking the Ionis convention that holds elsewhere - proof that maps must not be composed by analogy. || ON PURITY, the reviewer's challenge was tested against the specific documents it pointed at - the Waylivra and Tegsedi EPARs, downloaded and text-extracted in full, plus five FDA label section 11s. VERDICT: the reviewer is RIGHT that CMC sections state characterization methods, and WRONG that they state purity specifications. Both EPARs name the purity method precisely (IP-HPLC-UV-MS, the analyte being 'full-length n'), and both withhold every number, saying only that results were 'within the specifications'. One numerical limit does leak - total degradation products NMT 5.5% drug substance / NMT 7.0% drug product for volanesorsen - but that is a DIFFERENT ANALYTE from purity and hard rules 1/3/6 forbid converting it. So: 0 purity percentages recovered, purity_pct stays TBD for all 259; but purity_method must stop reading TBD for volanesorsen and inotersen. The prior record's phrase 'structurally unavailable' was too coarse - correct about the number, wrong about the method. || FINALLY, THREE NOTATION/SCHEMA GAPS that block storage of chemistry already in hand: rocksteady_v1 has no token for an UNMODIFIED ribonucleotide (so patisiran, which is mostly 2'-OH, cannot be written down, and a curator forced to pick from e/m/d/l/k would most likely write 'd' and turn RNA into DNA); no token for 3'-amino-3'-deoxyribose or N3'->P5' thiophosphoramidate (imetelstat); and no slot for a second strand or a conjugate attachment point (all three siRNA duplexes). It also carries no stereochemistry, though the Waylivra EPAR states volanesorsen is a reproducible diastereomeric mixture. These should be fixed in one notation revision.
